intent: Compare the average 25th-percentile SAT scores reported by test-optional and test-required colleges over the period from 1994 through 2010.

requirements.question: Are all required line series shown in every declared panel?
Compare the average 25th-percentile SAT scores reported by test-optional and test-required colleges over the period from 1994 through 2010.

For test-required colleges, the average 25th-percentile SAT score increased from 983.2609 in 1994 to 1103.2609 in 2010, with intermediate values of 1088.2609 (1998), 1108.2609 (2002), and 1128.2609 (2006).

Across 1994–2010, the average 25th-percentile SAT score for test-optional colleges was consistently higher than for test-required colleges at each reported year (1994: 993.2609 vs 983.2609; 1998: 1093.2609 vs 1088.2609; 2002: 1113.2609 vs 1108.2609; 2006: 1133.2609 vs 1128.2609; 2010: 1133.2609 vs 1103.2609).
